decisions.reason: As a niche men's series that is somewhat less central than the firm's core natural skincare lines, it likely revealed enough after several years to justify abandoning it if demand stayed limited and the broader line consumes disproportionate attention and shelf space.

Because this cleansing foam is a close extension of an established facial-care series, the cost of keeping the option open is likely low and its fit with the firm's core assortment makes continued marketing more attractive than withdrawal.
